candidates.change_summary: Change the function to always return false at the end instead of true.
Change the function to return the result of the last external call (bool _s) instead of always returning true.
Change the function to return true only if all external calls succeeded by aggregating with AND into allSuccess; otherwise revert remains as before.
Change the require to allow empty _tos arrays (removes the guard), so transfer can return true without making any external calls when _tos.length == 0.
Invert the call success check so that the function continues on failed external calls instead of reverting.
Change the call to use delegatecall instead of call, altering which context executes the transferFrom calls and thus observable effects.
Change the selector to transfer(address,address,uint256) so a different function on caddress is invoked, changing observable behavior.
Change the loop to iterate using <=, causing an out-of-bounds access and likely revert, altering observable behavior.
